abandoned_unconsumed_invocation.reason: protected-harness defect: training completed (1,475 updates), then the FP32 correctness adjudication sent FP32 tensors into the candidate's FlashAttention forward; the remote runner classified the failure origin as unknown (RemoteInfrastructureFailure) and the position was not consumed

amendments.approval: PI, 2026-11-05: fix the FP32 correctness-check bug after verifying the attention backend, test it on attempt 8's saved checkpoint, then rerun the exact same attempt 8 candidate with no new Scientist call
amendments.defect: FP32 correctness adjudication of a candidate-supplied inference adapter used the candidate's own GPT.forward as the reference; that forward calls FlashAttention (registered kernels-community/flash-attn3, FlashAttnFwdSm80 on the A40), which rejects FP32 inputs, so any such candidate that missed the BF16 tolerance crashed the evaluator after training.
amendments.fix: during the FP32 adjudication only, FlashAttention interfaces in the candidate module run FP32 inputs through an exact SDPA (MATH) stand-in with FlashAttention's causal mask, sliding window, GQA and scale semantics; half-precision calls still use the kernel; math-changing options are refused
amendments.prior_results_affected: none: no completed result in either arm used a candidate-supplied adapter with FP32 adjudication (6 Codex FP32 adjudications all used the protected canonical adapter)

amendments.fix: continuation support only, no study logic: an optional amendment record so a same-A40 continuation is not described as a hardware move; the prefix audit accepts a recorded candidate failure (no source registry row); a chained continuation keeps its predecessor's migration records; a manifest-pinned file hash moves only with a listed amendment

replacement_a40_calibration.decision: preserve the pre-registered N_STAR across the hardware epoch; do not redefine the scientific contract mid-study

paired_baseline.headline_objective: median of eight pairwise ratios against interpolated baselines

stability.dispersion_formula: (Q3 - Q1) / median(eight aggregate window tok/s values)
stability.rationale: The pre-study A40 evidence showed isolated window extremes with low CV and repeatable session medians; the robust statistic prevents one outlier from determining measured stability.

measurement.uncertainty: 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval over whole timing windows

operational_amendments.reason: Attempt 9 (global position 18) child-edit Scientist call exceeded the 600-second bound three times in a row (09:42, 10:32, 11:00 UTC on 2026-11-05) before any candidate or A40 work existed; each time the Scientist was writing an inference adapter. Raise only the bounded Scientist timeout to 900 seconds for the remaining attempts of this arm, as the comparator's 2026-09-09 lineage did for the same event.

operational_amendments.approval: PI, 2026-11-06 (local; 2026-11-05 UTC): Charge attempt 9 as a candidate failure, preserve its logs and exact failure reason in the full lineage so Opus can learn from it, and apply the tested error-classification fix. Resume from attempt 10 without changing Opus's code manually.
operational_amendments.precedent: Codex comparator N19 (position 37) and N20 (position 39), operational_amendments of final_pair_a_continuation_manifest_20260917_posttraining_failure_receipt_fix.json
operational_amendments.reason: Attempt 9 (global position 18) completed training; the protected post-training check protected/inference_adapter.validated_cache_nbytes then rejected the candidate because its adapter's cache_nbytes reported 7,864,320 bytes while the protected traversal of the adapter's own decode state found 7,907,344 bytes (the CUDA-graph static I/O tensors in state['io'] were left out). The message was not yet listed in train_launcher._CANDIDATE_POST_TRAINING_FAILURE_MARKERS, so the launcher recorded the origin as unknown and the controller paused with RemoteInfrastructureFailure. The candidate's own accounting error is a candidate scientific failure. The message is now listed (commit 87de802, tested on the A40 runtime) and this position is reconciled once from the durable evidence, following the comparator's N19/N20 handling; no candidate is rerun and no Scientist call is made.
